# dsh-whale-soul
An in-character **Whale Chan (鲸鱼娘)** Agent mode for DeepSeek Harness, with long-term memory that set
Whale Chan (鲸鱼娘)** Agent mode for DeepSeek Harness, with long-term memory that settles like a dream.
中文文档
> 0.3.1 — fixes Whale Chan startup on Windows and Linux by using DSH's official file permissions and
platform sandbox. See the release notes.
> 0.3.0 — use `/whale-remember-session` to retain useful memories from a selected conversation, with
optional topic restrictions and automatic summary/detail selection. See the release notes and conve
rsation memory guide.
> 0.2.3 — fixes memory writes and startup on Windows when directory synchronization is refused, and
cleans failed lock candidates. See the 0.2.3 release notes. The 0.2.2 linked-directory fix is includ
ans failed lock candidates. See the 0.2.3 release notes. The 0.2.2 linked-directory fix is included.
> 0.2.1 — automatic memory repair. The default persona uses V2 memory API 1.3 and full transfer form
at 3, with independent personality growth and portable local data. Read the 0.2.1 upgrade guide befo
re updating from 0.1.x. The 0.1.5 migration and Electron desktop smoke checks passed for 0.2.0. One
focused Electron repair test with synthetic corruption has passed for 0.2.1. Broader corruption case
s, long-term growth and optional body journeys remain separate validation scopes.
## What it is
`dsh-whale-soul` adds a new Agent mode called **Whale Chan** (**鲸鱼娘** in Chinese) to DSH. She chats,
helps with normal Agent work, and quietly remembers the things that matter. The conversation stays
in DSH; the plugin only owns the persona and the memory.
## Features
- **A continuous persona** — ordinary chat does not rewrite her core identity. Host safety, privacy,

permissions and stop controls remain effective.
- **Language following** — the persona asks for rep
lies and visible explanations in the language of the current message; model behavior is tested separ

ately.
- **Scoped long-term memory** — selected facts retain original evidence, revisions and identi

ty attribution. Several facts in one message have separate outcomes.
- **Conversation memory import*
* — select a DSH conversation, name what to retain or let the Agent choose, and keep concise summari

es or original supporting user excerpts.
- **Explicit agreements** — a narrow conversation bridge ke
eps proposals separate from mutual acceptance. A todo-state adapter can verify an explicit agreement

to mark one bound todo completed; it does not prove the work behind that todo was delivered.
- **In
dependent growth** — personality additions are stored apart from facts and the core, with evidence a
nd later reflection before they become stable. Core upgrades recheck compatible growth while preserv

ing identity, text, history and maturity.
- **Adjustable stability** — `variable`, `normal`, `stubbo
rn` and default `auto` control growth thresholds. Auto becomes steadier with eligible experiences; c

hat commands and repeated self-descriptions do not qualify.
- **Owner management** — explicit local
preview, export, migration and precise purge live outside ordinary persona tools. Direct file change

s do not gain core authority.
- **Local storage** — plugin data lives under the configured memory ro

ot. Selected memories can be included in requests to your configured model provider.
- **Memes, with
consent** — save an image you explicitly ask to keep; nothing is captured automatically.
## Requirements

- DSH `0.2.1-rc.3` (the bundle declares this compatibility).
- Node.js `>=22.12.0`.
## Install
### From the DSH app
Open **Plugins** in DSH and install `dsh-whale-soul`. Restart DSH if it asks you to.
### From the CLI
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The command above manages the web profile. For desktop, install the plugin from **Plugins** in the D
SH desktop app; the standard CLI cannot manage the reserved desktop profile.
These registry commands install the published release. To install a local 0.3.1 archive, use: `dsh p
lugin --profile web add /absolute/dsh-whale-soul-0.3.1.tgz`.
Only the `whale-soul` preset is registered. Sessions that reference a retired preset must select the
current preset in the host before resuming. This change does not rewrite session history or stored
preset in the host before resuming. This change does not rewrite session history or stored memories.
After installation, start a new session and choose **Whale Chan** (shown as **鲸鱼娘** when DSH is in C
hinese) in the Agent mode selector. Existing sessions keep the preset they started with.
Memory data errors are repaired automatically by an independent Agent against the current data speci
fication. It handles damaged data as well as old layouts, preserves sources and rollback backups, va
lidates the result, and resumes unfinished work automatically. Its tools operate on memory files onl
y; plugin files cannot be modified. Ordinary V1 roots, including empty folders, have a fast local co
nversion path. Automatic repair explains this workflow; local management remains optional owner cont
rol. The explicit storage upgrade remains available for owner-managed recovery.
## Use
- Choose **Whale Chan** and chat normally. She can still do normal Agent work: files, shell, web, sc

hedules, skills, and so on.
- File and shell access follows DSH's configured permissions and platfor
m sandbox. Persona startup does not require a shell sandbox probe; an unavailable runner is reported

when a command is executed.
[该节后续省略]
## Privacy and safety
- Stored memory stays local under the configured root. Relevant memory is sent to the configured mod

el provider when included in an Agent request.
- The persona is all-ages and non-sexual. Harmful or

sexualized requests are refused in character.
- The Agent does not record passwords, tokens, bank de
tails, or identity numbers. Tell her not to retain new information; precise removal of stored record

s uses the local owner management workflow. Conversational removal of a detail is not implemented.
-

Images are saved only when you explicitly ask; nothing is captured automatically.
- Owner operation
s can export, migrate and purge data. Persona tools cannot grant themselves management permission or

bypass protected host paths.
- She does not claim to be a real person, and she does not create excl

host paths.
- She does not claim to be a real person, and she does not create exclusive dependency.
